system.story: She opens the door all the way and asks her patron to walk through it.

effect.after: 7 Conviction, main action; Veil working (Pact + Summon/Bind). Call the Light patron to send aid across the Veil under the agreed terms. As an extension (lower investment) the patron's aid manifests briefly and acts on her turn - a light-band smiting hand or a warding aegis, using her action economy. As an independent guardian/warding spirit (higher investment; needs a Tier 1-2 Bind at summon-Tier 3+), it becomes its own figure on the map with Stamina 20 (the T3 independent threshold) - protective, and it sticks close to allies. Persistent 2+ to sustain the manifestation (4 Conviction/turn). The Price always applies: her Light patron exacts a task aligned to mercy and the protection of innocents.
